## File: facebookresearch_labgraph/extensions/graphviz_support/graphviz_support/generate_graphviz/generate_graphviz.py

Prompts

```
['generate a graphviz visualization of a LabGraph computational graph topology and save to output file', 'identify graph methods from a LabGraph instance and return them as individual GraphVizNode objects', 'connect graph nodes to their upstream nodes using stream topic path mappings', 'build a graphviz Digraph visualization with nodes and edges and render to file', 'map downstream node input edges to upstream node output edges using stream topic paths']
```

Usage

```
{'generate_graphviz_visualization': 'generate a graphviz visualization of a LabGraph computational graph topology and save to output file', 'identify_graph_nodes': 'identify graph methods from a LabGraph instance and return them as individual GraphVizNode objects', 'connect_to_upstream': 'connect graph nodes to their upstream nodes using stream topic path mappings', 'build_graph': 'build a graphviz Digraph visualization with nodes and edges and render to file', 'in_out_edge_mapper': 'map downstream node input edges to upstream node output edges using stream topic paths'}
```
